name: The Seer
source:
For the human cities to be able to survive, every one of them holds a spiritual guide called The Seer, someone gifted with the ability to read the oracles and magically gifted. 

This story follows Coral and his boyfriend Andrew, as Coral tries to get chosen as the apprentice to be the new Seer, while being plagued by visions of a dark future, and the world's magic nature starts to reveal itself to Andrew as he tries to support his boyfriend during the hard task.

The game is mostly focused on their relationships with people and the world around them, with fantasy elements in the background.

[From [url=https://matterdecay.itch.io/the-seer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了生存，每座人类城市都有一位被称为“先知”的精神引领者，既能解读神谕，也拥有魔法天赋。

故事围绕科拉尔与男友安德鲁展开。科拉尔努力争取成为下一任先知的学徒，却不断受到黑暗未来幻象的困扰。安德鲁则在支持男友面对艰难任务的过程中，逐渐认识到这个世界的魔法本质。

游戏主要关注两人与周围人们及世界的关系，奇幻元素则作为背景。

[摘自[url=https://matterdecay.itch.io/the-seer]itch.io[/url]]
